readings.title: The Tithe of the People for Yerushalayim
readings.subtitle: Volunteers and chosen representatives secure the centralized foundation of YeHoVaH's administration.
readings.text:
[Nehemiah 11:1] Now the rulers of the people dwelt at Yerushalayim, and the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to dwell in Yerushalayim, the set-apart city, and nine-tenths were to dwell in other cities.
[2] And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to dwell at Yerushalayim.
[3] And these are the heads of the province who dwelt in Yerushalayim, but in the cities of Yehuḏah everyone dwelt in his own possession in their cities – Yisra’ěl, the priests, and the Lěvites, and the Nethinim, and the sons of Shelomoh’s servants.

readings.subsection: The Vanguard of Judah and Benjamin
readings.title: Restoring the Tribal Framework
readings.subtitle: The brave men and overseers who anchored the physical restoration of the capital.

readings.title: Activating the Priestly Network
readings.subtitle: Mighty men appointed to operate the structural service of the House of Elohim.
readings.text:
[10] Of the priests: Yeḏayah son of Yoyariḇ, Yaḵin,
[11] Serayah son of Ḥilqiyah, son of Meshullam, son of Tsaḏoq, son of Merayoth, son of Aḥituḇ, was the leader of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>.
[12] And their brothers who did the work of the House were eight hundred and twenty-two; and Aḏayah son of Yeroḥam, son of Pelalyah, son of Amtsi, son of Zeḵaryah, son of Pashḥur, son of Malkiyah,
[13] and his brothers, heads of the fathers’ houses, were two hundred and forty-two; and Amashai son of Azar’ěl, son of Aḥzai, son of Meshillěmoth, son of Imměr,
[14] and their brothers, mighty brave ones, were one hundred and twenty-eight. And their overseer was Zaḇdi’ěl, son of the great ones.

readings.title: The Levites and the Architecture of Thanksgiving
readings.subtitle: Assigning the outside work, defensive guard duties, and the fundamental protocol of gratitude.
readings.text:
[15] Also of the Lěvites: Shemayah son of Ḥashshuḇ, son of Azriqam, son of Ḥashaḇyah, son of Bunni;
[16] and Shabbethai and Yozaḇaḏ, of the heads of the Lěvites, over the outside work of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>;
[17] and Mattanyah son of Miḵa, son of Zaḇdi, son of Asaph, who was the leader who began the thanksgiving with prayer, and Baqbuqyah the second among his brothers, and Aḇda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Yeḏuthun.
[18] All the Lěvites in the set-apart city were two hundred and eighty-four.
[19] And the gatekeepers, Aqquḇ, Talmon, and their brothers keeping guard at the gates, were one hundred and seventy-two.
[20] And the rest of Yisra’ěl, of the priests, Lěvites, were in all the cities of Yehuḏah, each one in his inheritance.
[21] But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel. And Tsiḥa and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.

readings.title: Royal Command and Daily Provision
readings.subtitle: The sovereign's deputy and the systematic support for the singers maintaining the spiritual atmosphere.
readings.text:
[22] And the overseer of the Lěvites at Yerushalayim was Uzzi son of Bani, son of Ḥashaḇyah, son of Mattanyah, son of Miḵa. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the work of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>,
[23] for the sovereign’s command was upon them – and support for the singers, a matter day by day.
[24] And Pethaḥyah son of Meshěyzaḇ’ěl, of the children of Zeraḥ son of Yehuḏah, was the sovereign’s deputy in all matters concerning the people.

readings.title: Reclaiming the Ancestral Fields
readings.subtitle: Securing the agricultural and geopolitical zones from Be’ěrsheḇa to the Valley of Hinnom.
readings.text:
[25] And at the villages with their fields, some of the children of Yehuḏah dwelt in Qiryath Arba and its villages, and in Diḇon and its villages, and in Yeqaḇtse’ěl and its villages,
[26] and in Yěshua, and in Molaḏah, and in Běyth Pelet,
[27] and in Ḥatsar Shu‛al, and in Be’ěrsheḇa and its villages,
[28] and in Tsiqlaḡ, and in Meḵonah and its villages,
[29] and in Ěn Rimmon, and in Tsorah, and in Yarmuth,
[30] Zanovaḥ, Aḏullam, and their villages; in Laḵish and its fields; in Azěqah and its villages. So they dwelt from Be’ěrsheḇa to the Valley of Hinnom.

readings.title: Reclaiming the Benjamite Inheritance
readings.subtitle: Re-establishing towns, valleys of craftsmen, and the strategic distribution of Levites.

readings.subsection: The First Wave of the Priesthood
readings.title: Returning with Zerubbabel
readings.subtitle: The foundational heads of the priesthood who led the initial extraction from Babylonian systems.
readings.text:
[Nehemiah 12:1] And these were the priests and the Lěvites who came up with Zerubbaḇel son of She’alti’ěl, and Yěshua: Serayah, Yirmeyah, Ezra,
[2] Amaryah, Malluḵ, Ḥattush,
[3] Sheḵanyah, Reḥum, Merěmoth,
[4] Iddo, Ginnethoi, Aḇiyah,
[5] Miyamin, Ma‛aḏyah, Bilgah,
[6] Shemayah, and Yoyariḇ, Yeḏayah,
[7] Sallu, Amoq, Ḥilqiyah, and Yeḏayah. These were the heads of the priests and their brothers in the days of Yěshua.

readings.title: The Lineage of the High Priesthood
readings.subtitle: The operational chain of command mapping the generational transfer of authority.
readings.text:
[8] And the Lěvites: Yěshua, Binnui, Qaḏmi’ěl, Shěrěḇyah, Yehuḏah, Mattanyah over the thanksgiving, he and his brothers.
[9] And Baqbuqyah and Unni, their brothers, were opposite them for guard duties.
[10] And Yěshua brought forth Yoyaqim, and Yoyaqim brought forth Elyashiḇ, and Elyashiḇ brought forth Yoyaḏa,
[11] and Yoyaḏa brought forth Yonathan, and Yonathan brought forth Yaddua.

readings.title: Heads of the Fathers' Houses
readings.subtitle: Identifying the leaders responsible for upholding the standard of Torah in the days of Yoyaqim.

readings.title: The Book of the Annals
readings.subtitle: Formal documentation of the trusted gatekeepers and praising guards authorized by David.
readings.text:
[22] The Lěvites and priests in the days of Elyashiḇ, Yoyaḏa, Yoḥanan, and Yaddua, were recorded heads of their fathers’ houses, also the priests in the reign of Dareyavesh the Persian.
[23] The sons of Lěvi, the heads of the fathers’ houses until the days of Yoḥanan son of Elyashiḇ, were written in the book of the annals.
[24] And the heads of the Lěvites were Ḥashaḇyah, Shěrěḇyah, and Yěshua son of Qaḏmi’ěl, with their brothers opposite them, to praise, to give thanks, watch opposite watch, according to the command of Daviḏ the man of <dn>Elohim</dn>.
[25] Mattanyah, and Baqbuqyah, Oḇaḏyah, Meshullam, Talmon, Aqquḇ were gatekeepers guarding at the storerooms of the gates.
[26] These were in the days of Yoyaqim son of Yěshua, son of Yotsaḏaq, and in the days of Neḥemyah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

readings.title: Re-entering the Possession
readings.subtitle: The Israelites, priests, and Levites who initiated the physical reclamation of the land.
readings.text:
[1 Chronicles 9:2] And the first inhabitants who were in their possessions in their cities of Yisra’ěl, were the priests, the Lěvites, and the Nethinim.
[3] And in Yerushalayim dwelt some of the children of Yehuḏah, and some of the children of Binyamin, and some of the children of Ephrayim and Menashsheh:
[4] Uthai son of Ammihuḏ, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, of the sons of Perets, the son of Yehuḏah.
[5] And of the Shilonites: Asayah the first-born and his sons.
[6] And of the sons of Zeraḥ: Ye‛u’ěl, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.

readings.title: The Benjamite Foundation in Yerushalayim
readings.subtitle: Generational records of the heads of fathers' houses authorized to re-establish the city.

readings.title: Able Men for the Work of the Service
readings.subtitle: The specialized officers and capable forces commissioned to operate the House of Elohim.

readings.title: The Levitical Cadre
readings.subtitle: Lineages responsible for leading worship and anchoring the surrounding villages.

readings.title: Securing the Sovereign's Gate
readings.subtitle: The trusted lineages assigned to protect the critical entry points of YeHoVaH's camp.
readings.text:
[17] And the gatekeepers: Shallum, and Aqquḇ, and Talmon, and Aḥiman, and their brothers – Shallum the chief.
[18] And up till then they were gatekeepers for the camps of the children of Lěvi at the Sovereign’s Gate on the east.
[19] And Shallum son of Qorě, son of Eḇyasaph, son of Qoraḥ, and his brothers, from his father’s house, the Qorḥites, were over the work of the service, guards of the thresholds of the Tent. And their fathers had been guards of the entrance to the camp of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[20] And Pineḥas son of El‛azar was leader over them in time past. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was with him.
[21] Zeḵaryah son of Meshelemyah was gatekeeper at the entrance of the Tent of Appointment.

readings.title: Appointed by Trust and Decree
readings.subtitle: The specific architecture of guarding the treasuries and opening the House morning by morning.
readings.text:
[22] All those chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. They were registered by genealogy, in their villages. Daviḏ and Shemu’ěl the seer had appointed them to their office of trust.
[23] So they and their sons were over the gates of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the House of the Tent, by watches.
[24] The gatekeepers were on the four sides: the east, west, north, and south.
[25] And their brothers in their villages had to come with them from time to time for seven days.
[26] For the four chief gatekeepers were in an office of trust. They were Lěvites, and they were over the rooms and treasuries of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>.
[27] And they spent the night all around the House of <dn>Elohim</dn> because they had the duty, and they were to open it morning by morning.

readings.title: Stewards of the Sacred Elements
readings.subtitle: Managing the vessels, spices, fine flour, and the continuous presentation of the showbread.
readings.text:
[28] And some of them were over the vessels of service, for they brought them in and took them out by count.
[29] And some of them were appointed over the vessels, even over all the vessels of the set-apart place, and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the incense and the spices.
[30] And some of the sons of the priests blended the compound of spices.
[31] And Mattithyah of the Lěvites, the first-born of Shallum the Qorḥite, was entrusted with the making of the flat cakes.
[32] And some of their brothers of the sons of the Qehathites were over the showbread, to prepare every Sabbath.

readings.title: The Continual Watch of the Singers
readings.subtitle: The Levite heads exempted from other duties to maintain the operational frequency day and night.
readings.text:
[33] And these were the singers, heads of the fathers’ houses of the Lěvites, in the rooms, and were exempted from other duties, for they were employed in that work day and night.
[34] These heads of the fathers’ houses of the Lěvites were heads throughout their generations. They dwelt at Yerushalayim.
